# Cross-Platform GUI Requirements Quality Checklist: Feature 010 (v0.3.0)

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, clarity, and completeness for the unified cross-platform `eframe`/`egui` GUI migration across Linux, Windows, and macOS.
**Created**: 2026-11-22
**Feature**: [specs/010-cross-platform-gui/spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [gui-components-and-cli-contract.md](../contracts/gui-components-and-cli-contract.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Feature Parity & UX Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are visual contrast and styling requirements for Dark and Light themes explicitly defined using standard Unicode glyphs rather than external asset fonts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK002 Are inline-editing and commit requirements clearly specified for both Title and Artist columns in the playlist table? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are multi-row selection behaviors and bulk action requirements (bulk delete, bulk DSP) consistently specified across the playlist interface? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 Are two-step confirmation requirements explicitly defined for destructive device reformatting prior to export? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK005 Are undo and redo stack boundary constraints and supported operation classes documented unambiguously? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §1]

## 2. Windows & Platform Interop Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK006 Is the Windows console attachment behavior explicitly defined to distinguish GUI double-click launches from CLI argument invocations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contract §1]
- [ ] CHK007 Are Win32 storage API requirements and drive letter filtering rules (`GetLogicalDrives`/`GetDriveTypeW`) documented for removable media detection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Contract §3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the fallback requirement for unsupported platform storage enumeration (macOS empty-device state) specified without error panics? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK009 Is backward compatibility for all existing CLI subcommands (`status`, `scan`, `tag`, `save`, `export`, `export-text`, `check-compat`) fully verified in requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Contract §1]

## 3. Zero-GTK3 & Footprint Gates Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Are the complete removal of GTK3, Cocoa, and Objective-C crates and dependencies mandated across all build configurations? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK011 Is `rfd`'s Linux backend explicitly constrained to `xdg-portal` to guarantee zero compile-time and runtime GTK3 linkage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Research §1]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the standalone release executable size gate quantified with an explicit ceiling (< 20 MB) across Linux, Windows, and macOS? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK013 Are release compilation profile optimizations (`lto`, `codegen-units = 1`, `strip`) explicitly documented in the build specification? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]

## 4. Concurrency & Safety Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Are audio preview termination requirements explicitly defined before initiating in-place DSP file modifications? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are background thread communication protocols (`mpsc` progress channels and `ctx.request_repaint()`) specified to prevent UI freezing during batch operations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Data Model §3]
- [ ] CHK016 Are zero-tempfile and atomic write requirements specified for DSP batch processing and removable media exports? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Constitution §IV]

## 5. Cross-Platform Headless Testing Requirements Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Are headless GUI interaction test requirements specified using `egui_kittest` under standard `cargo test` without display server dependencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021, Contract §4]
- [ ] CHK018 Are continuous integration requirements updated to remove `libgtk-3-dev` and `xvfb` while enforcing cross-platform test and binary size gates? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK018) for traceability.
